statement.zh: 有界的记录确定历程，记录长度恰好。界给定时归纳即演绎：给定界的学习者从 2N − 1 起每步都对且不能更早；未给定界的学习者在界给出的一步之前静止。有限的名命名有意义的切分，不用商。
statement.en: A bounded record fixes the course at an exact length. With the bound given, induction is deduction: the learner given it is right from 2N − 1 on and none can always speak sooner; the learner not given it rests by a step the bound gives. Finite names name the split that makes sense, with no quotient.

laws.zh: 两个周期（Fine–Wilf）：周期为 p + 1、在前 p 步都在 Q 步后回来的历程在每一步都在 Q 步后回来；从 i、i' 起以周期 q + 1、q' + 1 重复的两个历程在 (i + q + 1) + (i' + q') 之前相同，就处处相同。
laws.en: Two periods (Fine–Wilf): a course with period p + 1 that comes back after Q steps at each of its first p steps comes back after Q steps at every step; two courses repeating from i, i′ with periods q + 1, q′ + 1 that agree before (i + q + 1) + (i′ + q′) agree at every step.

laws.zh: 历程至多有 N 个状态（StatesBelow o N：每一时刻与 N 之前的某一时刻是同一状态），恰当它从某步 i 起以某个周期 q + 1 重复，且 i + q + 1 ≤ N。
laws.en: A course has at most N states (StatesBelow o N: every moment is one state with some moment before N) exactly where it repeats from some step i with some period q + 1, i + q + 1 ≤ N.

laws.zh: 至多 N 与至多 N' 个状态的两个历程在 N + N' − 1 之前相同，就处处相同；记录相等恰当历程在其长度之前相同；所以长 N + N' − 1 的记录确定历程。
laws.en: Two courses with at most N and at most N′ states that agree before N + N′ − 1 agree at every step; records are equal exactly where the courses agree before their length; so the record before N + N′ − 1 fixes the course.

laws.zh: 给出两个值：对每个 T，一个状态的历程与至多 T + 1 个状态的历程长 T 的记录相同而在 T 不同；对每个 M，两个至多 M + 2 个状态的历程长 M + M + 2 的记录相同而在那里不同。对每一对 M、M′，至多 M + 1 与至多 M′ + 1 个状态的两个历程，长 M + M′ 的记录相同而在第 M + M′ 步不同：长度 N + N′ − 1 对每一对界恰好。
laws.en: Given two values: for every T, a course with one state and one with at most T + 1 share their record before T and differ at T; for every M, two courses with at most M + 2 states share their record before M + M + 2 and differ there. For every M and M′, a course with at most M + 1 states and one with at most M′ + 1 share their record before M + M′ and differ at step M + M′: the length N + N′ − 1 is exact for every pair of bounds.

laws.zh: 至多 N 个状态时，两个时刻是同一状态，恰当其后所识在 N + N − 1 步内相同：状态从有限的记录读出。
laws.en: With at most N states, two moments are one state exactly where what follows them agrees for N + N − 1 steps: the states are read off a finite record.

laws.zh: 至多 N 个状态的历程上，N 之内（i + q + 1 ≤ N）、在 N + N − 1 之前的记录上成立的套索 (i, q) 每步都成立；值可判定时，N 之内的套索假设在 N + N − 1 之前不被否证，就处处不被否证，且总有这样的假设：归纳即演绎。
laws.en: On a course with at most N states, a lasso (i, q) within N (i + q + 1 ≤ N) that holds on the record before N + N − 1 holds at every step; with values decided, a lasso hypothesis within N unrefuted before N + N − 1 is unrefuted everywhere, and one always is: induction is deduction.

laws.zh: 给定 N 的学习者（withBound N）在 N + N − 1 之前不说，之后以第一个在 N 之内、为记录所证实的套索假设主张；在每个至多 N 个状态的历程上，它处处不被否证，从 N + N − 1 起每步都对。
laws.en: The learner given N (withBound N) is silent before N + N − 1 and then claims by the first lasso hypothesis within N that the record bears out; on every course with at most N states it is refuted nowhere and is right at every step from N + N − 1 on.

laws.zh: 没有学习者能总是更早说：给出两个值，没有学习者在每个至多 M + 2 个状态的历程上都处处不被否证、且在第 M + M + 2 步都作主张。
laws.en: None can always speak sooner: given two values, no learner is refuted nowhere on every course with at most M + 2 states and claims at step M + M + 2 on each.

laws.zh: withBound 2 对二值否定从第 3 步起每步都对；other 移动每个值时，回答给定 N 的学习者的历程超出 N 个状态。
laws.en: withBound 2 is right about the two-valued negation at every step from 3 on; where other moves every value, the course answering the learner given N has more than N states.

laws.zh: 至多 N 个状态且值可判定时，N 之内的套索假设 (a, b)（a ≤ s）在 s 到 s + (N + N − 1) 之前的每步不被否证，就从 s 起每步不被否证；对套索假设的按否证学习者从第 N + (N + N − 1) · tri N 步起每步主张且正确；套索历程上有这样的一步。
laws.en: With at most N states and values decided, a lasso hypothesis (a, b) within N, a ≤ s, unrefuted at every step from s to before s + (N + N − 1) is unrefuted at every step from s on; the learner by refutation over the lasso hypotheses claims and is right at every step from N + (N + N − 1) · tri N on; on a lasso course there is such a step.

laws.zh: 轨道被列表 l 所持时，以 N 为 l 的长度亦然。
laws.en: Where an orbit is held by a list l, the same holds with N the length of l.

laws.zh: 列表 l 在律下封闭时，成员 s、s' 的所识的未来相同，恰当它们在 l.length + l.length − 1 步内相同；l 持有每个配置时，以这一长度的所识的未来命名（Law.name）有意义，不用商，承载规律，值可判定时判定相同。
laws.en: For a list l closed under the law, members s, s′ have the same registered future exactly where those futures agree for l.length + l.length − 1 steps; where l holds every configuration, naming by the registered future of that length (Law.name) makes sense with no quotient, carries the law and, values decided, decides likeness.

laws.zh: Moore 界：确定的律下，N 个成员的列表对律封闭、成员的值判定相同时，两个成员的所识的未来相同，恰当它们在 N − 1 步内相同。在 k + 1 步内相同（Law.AgreeTo）是一条等价链，每一步比前一步细；值不同的成员给出两类，每次严格细分多一类，两两分开的成员不多于列表，所以链在 N − 2 步之内停止细分，律确定，此后不再细分。不判定时，处处相同不被否证。对每个 N ≥ 2 恰好：N 个位置的路径走到停住的最后一个，只识是否到了最后，前两个位置在 N − 2 步内相同而在下一步不同。值已定、至多 N 个状态的历史的两个时刻，恰在 N − 1 步内相同时是同一状态。
laws.en: Moore's bound: under a determined law on a list of N members closed under it, with the members' values compared decidedly, two members have the same registered future exactly where they agree for N − 1 steps. Agreeing for k + 1 steps (Law.AgreeTo) is a chain of equivalences, each finer than the one before; members with different values make two classes, each strict refinement adds one, and members pairwise apart are no more than the list, so the chain stops refining within N − 2 steps and, the law being determined, never refines again. With no decision, that they agree everywhere is refuted by nothing. Exact for every N ≥ 2: on a path of N positions to a last one that stays, registering only whether the last is reached, the first two positions agree for N − 2 steps and differ at the next. Two moments of a history with at most N states and decided values are one state exactly where they agree for N − 1 steps.

laws.zh: Moore 界不加前提：确定的律下，N 个成员的列表对律封闭时，两个成员的所识的未来相同，恰当它们在 N − 1 步内相同，不判定任何值。判定的是位置，不是值：律在列表的位置上读出（Law.orbit_memberAt；有限多个存在一并选出，不用选择公理），位置的相同是已定的；把记录中的一致在每一步所连的两个位置逐对合并（Law.merge、Law.joinOrbits），得到位置的一个标记，每个标记只有一个值（Law.joinOrbits_sound）；这个标记在 N − 1 步内一致，值已定的 Moore 界对它成立，再回到值。至多 N 个状态的历史的两个时刻，恰在 N − 1 步内相同时是同一状态，同样不加前提。
laws.en: Moore's bound with no premise: under a determined law on a list of N members closed under it, two members have the same registered future exactly where they agree for N − 1 steps, with no value compared decidedly. What is decided is the positions, not the values: the law is read on the positions of the list (Law.orbit_memberAt; finitely many existences chosen together, with no axiom of choice), whose equality is decided; joining, pair by pair, the two positions the record's agreement joins at each step (Law.merge, Law.joinOrbits) gives a labelling of the positions whose labels have one value each (Law.joinOrbits_sound); the labelling agrees for N − 1 steps, Moore's bound with decided values holds for it, and it carries over to the values. Two moments of a history with at most N states are one state exactly where they agree for N − 1 steps, with no premise too.

hypotheses.zh: 不加公理；除了状态数的界不加前提：界写在每条定理之中（StatesBelow o N，或世界被长度为 N 的列表持有）。
hypotheses.en: No axiom; no premise beyond the bound on states, written into each theorem (StatesBelow o N, or a world held by a list of length N).

hypotheses.zh: 学习者与按名判定相同要所识的值可判定（DecidableEq O、DecidableEq R），即 learning-by-refutation 的“值可判定”；bounded_agree、lasso_of_fits、Law.name_identifiesAlike 不要。
hypotheses.en: The learner and deciding likeness by names need registered values decided (DecidableEq O, DecidableEq R), the ‘values decided’ of learning-by-refutation; bounded_agree, lasso_of_fits and Law.name_identifiesAlike do not.

hypotheses.zh: 只陈述确定的律与单个所识的历程；有分支的框架与概率没有陈述。
hypotheses.en: Only determined laws and single registered courses are stated; branching frames and probabilities are not.

hypotheses.zh: Moore 界以类计的形式（Law.sameFuture_iff_classes、Identification.sameAhead_iff_classes）要成员的值两两判定相同（对列表中的每一对，Decided，不要判定程序）；Law.sameFuture_iff_within 与 Identification.sameAhead_iff_within 不要：它们判定位置（Nat 的相等），不判定值。Law.sameFuture_classes_unrefuted 不要，只说处处相同不被否证。
hypotheses.en: Moore's bound in its counting form (Law.sameFuture_iff_classes, Identification.sameAhead_iff_classes) needs the members' values compared decidedly (Decided for each pair of the list, no decision procedure); Law.sameFuture_iff_within and Identification.sameAhead_iff_within do not: they decide positions (equality in Nat), not values. Law.sameFuture_classes_unrefuted does not, and states only that agreeing everywhere is refuted by nothing.

does_not_show.zh: 静止之步 N + (2N − 1)·tri N 粗，不是最优。
does_not_show.en: The rest step N + (2N − 1)·tri N is coarse, not optimal.

detail.zh: record_short：一个状态的历程与 T + 1 个状态的历程有相同的长 T 的记录而在 T 不同；record_short_twice：两个 M + 2 个状态的历程（每 M + 2 步与每 M + 1 步标记一次）有相同的长 M + M + 2 的记录而在那里不同；bounded_agree_exact：对每一对 M、M′，以周期 M + 1 标记、标记落在第 M + M′ 步的历程，与在第 M′ 步之前随它、之后不标记的历程，有相同的长 M + M′ 的记录而在那里不同；answer_exceeds_bound：回答给定 N 的学习者的历程超出 N 个状态；Law.sameFuture_classes_exact：对每个 M，M + 2 个位置走到停住的最后一个、只识是否到了最后的路径上，前两个位置在 M 步内相同而在第 M 步不同。
detail.en: record_short: a course with one state and one with T + 1 share their record before T and differ at T; record_short_twice: two courses with M + 2 states (marking every M + 2 and every M + 1 steps) share their record before M + M + 2 and differ there; bounded_agree_exact: for every M and M′, the course marking one step in every M + 1, with a mark at M + M′, and the course following it before M′ and unmarked from then on share their record before M + M′ and differ there; answer_exceeds_bound: the course answering the learner given N exceeds N states; Law.sameFuture_classes_exact: for every M, on the path of M + 2 positions to a last one that stays, registering only whether the last is reached, the first two positions agree for M steps and differ at step M.

next_delta.zh: 未给定界的学习者的最优静止之步；Ren 对“按情境就是界”与有限名读法的判断。
next_delta.en: The optimal rest step of the learner not given the bound; Ren's judgment on reading ‘situationally’ as the bound and on the finite-name reading.

correspondence.zh: Ren 2026-10-12 的推测“the full "truth" can be derived, situationally, including the cognition/controller part”与其后的“keep prove to the deepest … for the open questions, if they need to be answered to move forward, answer them”：这里回答 Description、Diagonal 与 Context 留下的后两个开放问题：从有限的记录推出律，以及不加公理命名有意义的切分的类。learning-by-refutation 给出不用界的一面（没有记录确定下一个值；学习者静止这一点不被否证）；这里给出界给定的一面与恰好的边界，并给出未给定界的学习者静止之步（由界给出，学习者的记录不表明它）。已知的结果：Fine 与 Wilf（1965）的两个周期定理，Moore（1956）的有限实验，Gold（1967）的极限中的辨识；这里在核心中不用公理重证并连成一体。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：“按情境”就是界；有限的记录是一个投影，界使它对历程不失去什么；控制者在有界的世界之内，只有回答它的世界使它落空，而那超出界；有界时类的名是它的有限的未来；给定界与未给定界的差别在何时对与能否知道已对，不在最后是否对。
correspondence.en: Ren's speculation on 12 October 2026, ‘the full "truth" can be derived, situationally, including the cognition/controller part’, and the later ‘keep prove to the deepest … for the open questions, if they need to be answered to move forward, answer them’: this answers the last two questions Description, Diagonal and Context left open, deriving the law from a finite record and naming with no axiom the classes of the split that makes sense. Learning by refutation gives the side with no bound (no record fixes the next value; the learner's coming to rest is unrefuted); this gives the side with the bound given, its exact boundary, and the step by which the learner not given the bound rests, which the bound gives and the learner's record does not show. Known results: Fine and Wilf's two periods (1965), Moore's finite experiments (1956), Gold's identification in the limit (1967), here reproved in the core with no axiom and connected. Readings (the AI's, pending Ren): ‘situationally’ is the bound; a finite record is a projection, which the bound makes lose nothing of the course; the controller is inside the bounded world, and only a world answering it defeats it, which exceeds the bound; with a bound, a class's name is its finite future; being given the bound and not being given it differ in when the learner is right and whether it can know it is, not in whether it ends right.

detail.zh: 复用 Learning.Lasso、lasso_of_held、lasso、lasso_claims、lasso_holds、Holds、RefutedAt、record、back_record、back_made、holdFrom、lassoNext 与 diagonal_unrested：界给定时补上它在界未知时的结果；复用按否证学习的 learner、lassos、index 及其引理与 lasso_learner_bounded，给出它的静止之步。
detail.en: Reuses Learning.Lasso, lasso_of_held, lasso, lasso_claims, lasso_holds, Holds, RefutedAt, record, back_record, back_made, holdFrom, lassoNext and diagonal_unrested: it completes, with the bound given, what that record states with the bound unknown; reuses the learner by refutation (learner, lassos, index and its lemmas, lasso_learner_bounded) to state the step at which it rests.

output.zh: 套索、记录、否证与回答的历程；按否证学习者及其否证之界。
output.en: Lassos, records, refutation and the answering course; the learner by refutation and its bound on refutations.

input.zh: 有界的记录确定历程；给定界的学习者；未给定界的学习者的静止之步。
input.en: A bounded record fixes the course; the learner given the bound; the step at which the learner not given it rests.

detail.zh: 复用 SameAhead、StatesBelow、shared_below、statesBelow_of_same、lasso_iff_sameAhead 与 Negation：状态的界就是套索的界。
detail.en: Reuses SameAhead, StatesBelow, shared_below, statesBelow_of_same, lasso_iff_sameAhead and Negation: the bound on states is the bound on the lasso.

detail.zh: 复用 IdentifiesAlike、Law.registered、Law.SameFuture、Law.alike_iff_sameFuture 与 Law.IdentifiesAlike.carries：有限的名是有意义的切分。
detail.en: Reuses IdentifiesAlike, Law.registered, Law.SameFuture, Law.alike_iff_sameFuture and Law.IdentifiesAlike.carries: the finite name is the split that makes sense.

conditions.en: A world held by a list.

input.zh: 余数与套索世界的位置。
input.en: Remainders and the lasso world's positions.

detail.zh: 那里从内部不能同时持有每个读法；这里有界的历程的律可以推出，回答自己的学习者的世界超出界。
detail.en: There, no registration within holds every reading at once; here, a bounded course's law is derived, and a world answering its own learner exceeds the bound.

detail.zh: 推广恰在归并之处；这里界使有限的数据确定整个历程。
detail.en: Generalization is exactly where it lumps; here the bound makes finite data fix the whole course.

detail.zh: 其“学习”一项说按否证学习者静止这一点不被否证；held_learner_rests 给出这一步，是列表长度的函数，学习者自己没有它。
detail.en: Its learning clause says the learner by refutation's coming to rest is unrefuted; held_learner_rests states the step, a function of the list's length, which the learner does not have.

statements, proofs and theorem counts unchanged; prose describing these declarations follows the new words: “the learner that knows the bound” becomes “the learner given the bound”, `knowing N` becomes `withBound N`, and “two-valued denial” becomes “two-valued negation”; Lean sources: Identification, Description, Unfolding only renamed (with the matching docstrings); bindings move to the new receipts (see validation scope); the study only adds section 112 (general laws and renames) and its paragraph in the English summary; chapter: §9 gains rows for Stock, LossMatching and Contacts, rewrites six rows (Capture, TimedResponse, Revision, ReferencePlan, ContinuingRevision, RepairComparison) and drops the P83 label of the Identification row; the consolidated totals follow receipt 20261013T204910.042715Z (4861 theorems, 6856 declaration audits, 86 closure modules) and the complete-episode paragraph cites that receipt; renamed Lean names in the text and glossary take their new names, and the former wording becomes “the learner given the bound” and “perturbing the state alone”; title changed from “Identification: a bounded record fixes the course, at an exact length; where the bound is given induction is deduction, the learner that knows the bound is right from 2N − 1 on and none can always speak sooner, and the learner that does not know it rests by a step the bound gives; the split that makes sense is named with finite names, with no quotient” to “Identification: a bounded record fixes the course, at an exact length; where the bound is given induction is deduction, the learner given the bound is right from 2N − 1 on and none can always speak sooner, and the learner not given it rests by a step the bound gives; the split that makes sense is named with finite names, with no quotient”. This record's claim, premises and status are unchanged; no reproof is credited.

Law 6 states a condition bounded_induction carries that the old claim left to context, “within N” (within: i + q + 1 ≤ N); law 10 says “values decided”, which unrefuted_persists and learner_rests carry (DecidableEq O) and the old text stated only in the hypotheses, for the learner; law 2 writes out the definition of StatesBelow (every moment is one state with some moment before N). “No Lean axiom is used”, with no ethical premise among the hypotheses, cites the standard boundary no-ethical-premise. Work-item numbers became names: P70, the source of StatesBelow in the claim, is carried by the dependency the-split-that-makes-sense; in the hypotheses “P73's ‘values decided’” became that of learning-by-refutation; in the correspondence “P83 (work board)” and the times of Ren's messages, 05:12 and 06:01, are in this record's first history note, “P70–P72 left open” became what Description, Diagonal and Context left open, P73 became learning-by-refutation, and “See §97 of the integration note” joined the evidence (author counterreview in the integration note); in next_delta P69's Alike and P76's tests became Alike of Becoming.Unfolding and the tests of Becoming.Histories, and “(by whichever lands second)”, an arrangement of the work, is kept here. The theorem, module and audit counts of the evidence and the periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z stay in the receipts and the last text_versions entry. No law, premise, status, proof binding or source hash changed. Every earlier sentence is mapped in the migration table [identification-where-bounded.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/identification-where-bounded.md); the exact earlier record is the last text_versions entry.

history.zh: 2026-10-15 P83c：按 Ren 2026-10-12 06:01 的“keep prove to the deepest … for the open questions, if they need to be answered to move forward, answer them”与 2026-10-15 的“offer it to them, keep proving”，完成 next_delta 中的“同一世界的 Moore 界”：新增核心模块 Becoming.Refinement（精化链在其类数之内停止，Refining.steady_within）与 Identification 中的 Moore 界（Law.sameFuture_iff_classes，值已定，N − 1 步；Law.sameFuture_classes_unrefuted，不判定时不被否证；Law.sameFuture_classes_exact，对每个 N ≥ 2 恰好；Identification.sameAhead_iff_classes，同一历史）；新增第十三条规律与一项假设，反例增补，删去“同一历史、同一世界的更锐的 Moore 界没有陈述”，代以“不判定时是否成立没有表明”；“有分支的框架下的辨识”由 tests-fix-likeness-where-determined 的新规律回答（一个框架之内深度 N − 1，恰好；两个框架之间 N + N′ − 1），从 next_delta 移去；Identification 的引用哈希指向新字节，新增 Refinement 的引用与证明绑定（待整合者的合并检查器运行后重新指向）。见整合文档 §128。断言的其余部分不变。
history.en: 2026-10-15 P83c: following Ren's ‘keep prove to the deepest … for the open questions, if they need to be answered to move forward, answer them’ of 12 October 2026 06:01 and ‘offer it to them, keep proving’ of 15 October, the next_delta item ‘Moore's bound for one world’ is done: the core module Becoming.Refinement is added (a chain of equivalences stops within its classes, Refining.steady_within), with Moore's bound in Identification (Law.sameFuture_iff_classes, values decided, N − 1 steps; Law.sameFuture_classes_unrefuted, refuted by nothing with no decision; Law.sameFuture_classes_exact, exact for every N ≥ 2; Identification.sameAhead_iff_classes, for one history). A thirteenth law and a hypothesis are added and the counterexamples extended; ‘Moore's sharper bound for one history or one world is not stated’ gives way to ‘whether it holds with no decision is not shown’. ‘Identification for branching frames’ is answered by the new law of tests-fix-likeness-where-determined (depth N − 1 within one frame, exactly; N + N′ − 1 across two) and leaves next_delta. The Identification reference hash points to the new bytes, and a Refinement reference and proof binding are added, re-pointed after the integrator's consolidated checker run. See §128 of the integration note. The rest of the claim is unchanged.

history.zh: 2026-10-15 P83d：按 Ren 2026-10-12 06:01 的“keep prove to the deepest … for the open questions, if they need to be answered to move forward, answer them”与 2026-10-15 的“offer it to them, keep proving”，回答 next_delta 中的“不判定时 Moore 界 N − 1 是否成立”：成立，不加前提。新增第十四条规律（Law.sameFuture_iff_within、Identification.sameAhead_iff_within：判定位置而不判定值，经位置的逐对合并）；第四项假设写出这两条不要判定；删去“未表明”中“不判定时 Moore 界 N − 1 是否成立没有表明”一项与 next_delta 中的相应一项；Identification 的引用指向新字节并列出新声明（只增加声明，已有声明不变）；验证范围待整合者的核心检查器运行后重新指向。见整合文档 §130。断言的其余部分不变。
history.en: 2026-10-15 P83d: following Ren's ‘keep prove to the deepest … for the open questions, if they need to be answered to move forward, answer them’ of 12 October 2026 06:01 and ‘offer it to them, keep proving’ of 15 October, the next_delta item ‘whether Moore's bound N − 1 holds with no decision’ is answered: it holds, with no premise. A fourteenth law is added (Law.sameFuture_iff_within, Identification.sameAhead_iff_within: positions decided, not values, by joining positions pair by pair); the fourth hypothesis states that these two need no decision; the does_not_show item ‘whether Moore's bound N − 1 holds with no decision is not shown’ and the corresponding next_delta item are removed; the Identification reference points to the new bytes and lists the new declarations (declarations only added, earlier ones unchanged); the validation scope is re-pointed after the integrator's core checker run. See §130 of the integration note. The rest of the claim is unchanged.

history.en: 2026-10-15 P83e: the next_delta item ‘the instance theorem to alike_iff_sameTests’ is answered by the fourteenth law of tests-fix-likeness-where-determined (Law.sameTests_iff_within of Becoming.Distinguishing: under a determined law read through a registration, in a world of N configurations two configurations pass the same tests exactly where their registered futures agree for N − 1 steps; across two worlds N + N′ − 1, exact for every pair) and is removed from next_delta. See §131 of the integration note. Laws, premises and proof bindings are unchanged.
